_comment: Cairn's interface strings. Flat key against text, the same shape every Vintage Story mod ships in assets/<domain>/lang/. Placeholders are {0}, {1} and keep their meaning across languages. A key ending -one or -other is a plural form; see LanguageCatalog.Plural.
pack-gameversion-unusable: Pack 'gameVersion' is not a usable version string: '{0}'. Write a bare version like "1.22.5" — the game silently reads ">=1.22.5" as major version 0, which matches everything.
home-explain: Quit, reconnect it, and start Cairn again to carry on where you left off. Using the default location starts empty and leaves everything where it is.
importsrc-from-text: From pasted text or a file
importsrc-nothing-yet: Nothing downloads yet — this creates the pack, and the mods arrive when you sync it.
importsrc-install-explain: Builds a pack from the mods you already have, at the versions you are running. Your own Vintage Story is left exactly as it is.
importsrc-link-explain: Fetches what the link names and shows you what is in it — who published it, and every mod and version it would install — before anything is taken.
importsrc-text-explain: Paste an exported pack, or the path to one on this machine. Something in your hand is different from a link, and imports directly.
importsrc-text-placeholder: Paste the pack JSON here, or a path to a .cairn.json file
import-nothing-yet: Nothing downloads yet — adding this creates the pack, and the mods arrive when you sync it.
packupdate-explain: Mods you added yourself are left alone. Applying updates the pack; the next Play installs it.
packupdate-reset: Reset to the author's pack exactly, discarding my changes
pin-do-not: Do not pin — offer this mod for update when you check.
worldimport-heading: Bring a world into this pack
worldimport-explain: A world only opens against the mods it was made with, so it belongs in the pack that has them. Ticked worlds are copied — your own stay exactly where they are.
prefs-home-explain: Packs, game versions, runtimes and caches — all of it lives here.
prefs-home-env-set: CAIRN_HOME is set, and it outranks anything chosen here — so moving from this window would change nothing. Unset it to use this, or carry on moving the directory yourself and pointing CAIRN_HOME at it.
prefs-uiscale-explain: Scales everything — text, buttons, rows and spacing — rather than only the font, so nothing ends up cramped inside a control that stayed the same size. Applies straight away and is remembered.
provision-explain: The game and its .NET runtime are several hundred megabytes; this only happens once per version.
quickimport-explain: Paste a shared pack, or a URL to one. Someone else's export reproduces their exact mod versions.
quickimport-placeholder: Paste the pack JSON here, or a https:// URL
empty-no-pack: No pack selected. Click “New pack” to create one.
newpack-download-note: Anything you do not already have is downloaded for you, along with the .NET runtime it needs.
newpack-connect-note: Leave blank to start at the main menu — you can still join servers from there.
mods-search-placeholder: Search ModDB to add a mod…
packsettings-description-watermark: What is this pack for, and who is it for?
packsettings-optimum-explain: Compiles a faster community build of the game on this machine. Takes a while and needs several GB.
packsettings-connect-note: Leave blank to start at the main menu — you can still join servers from there.
packsettings-worlds-explain: This pack's saves and mod configs are its own. Created on first launch.
packsettings-bring-world-explain: Copies a world out of your own Vintage Story install and into this pack, where its mods are. Your copy stays where it is.
packsettings-share-explain: Writes one file others can import. With the lockfile included they get the exact versions you have.
packsettings-share-follower-explain: This pack is someone else's — pass on its link rather than a copy, so it stays theirs and whoever you send it to keeps getting your author's updates.
hotkeys-search-placeholder: Search by name, mod or key
hotkeys-footer: Saved into the pack as you go, so anyone who imports it gets them. They fill in bindings a player has not set; they never replace one.
hotkeys-unlock-tip: A control the player's hands know. Unlock it if you mean to move it.
hotkeys-unbind-tip: Leave this hotkey on no key at all.
hotkeys-reset-tip: Forget the pack's choice and use whatever the mod ships.
log-copy-diagnostics-tip: Version, platform, game installs, every mod in this pack and the log — copied for you to paste wherever you report it. Nothing is sent.
home-reassurance: Nothing has been read, written or deleted. Your packs are wherever that path leads, and will be there again when it does.
worldimport-none: No worlds in your Vintage Story install.
worldimport-available-one: {0} world in your Vintage Story install. Tick any you want a copy of.
worldimport-available-other: {0} worlds in your Vintage Story install. Tick any you want a copy of.
worldimport-copying-one: Copying {0} world ({1}). Your own copies stay where they are.
worldimport-copying-other: Copying {0} worlds ({1}). Your own copies stay where they are.
optimum-stopped: The build was stopped. Nothing was changed.
modconfig-log-kept: {0}: left {1} alone — it has been changed here
modconfig-log-kept-why: {0}: left {1} alone — it has been changed here ({2})
modconfig-log-released: {0}: the pack no longer sets {1}, leaving it as it is
modconfig-log-missing: {0}: {1} is not a setting this mod has
modconfig-why-version: 'version' belongs to ConfigLib, and setting it makes ConfigLib reset every setting in this file to the mod's defaults
modconfig-why-value-not-section: the file has a single value where the pack has a section
modconfig-why-not-yet: it is not there yet — this pack's values will apply from the next launch
modconfig-why-list: its top level is a list rather than a set of settings
modconfig-why-comments: it has comments in it that saving would erase
modconfig-why-yaml: it has YAML in it that Cairn cannot edit safely
modconfig-path-backslash: it uses backslashes — write the separator as '/'
modconfig-path-absolute: it is an absolute path, and must be relative to ModConfig/
modconfig-path-empty-segment: it has an empty path segment
modconfig-path-bad-characters: it has characters that are not allowed in a file name
modconfig-path-extension: Cairn can only carry .json and .yaml config files
pack-modconfig-empty: Pack 'modConfig' entry '{0}' has no values under it.
pack-modconfig-too-big: Pack 'modConfig' is {0}KB, over the {1}KB limit. It carries the values that make mods agree with each other, not a copy of each mod's whole config file.
mods-pin-tip-pinned: Pinned to {0}. Click to stop pinning and follow this mod again.
mods-pin-tip: Pin this mod to a version, so it stays put when you update the others.
share-slug-fixed: The address is fixed once published — links to it are already out there.
share-connect-warning: This pack carries the server address {0}.
pin-no-release: No release of {0} is marked for game {1}.
modconfig-intro: Settings you have changed in your mods' own config files. Tick one to carry it in the pack, and everyone who installs it gets your value.
modconfig-carried-one: {0} setting carried in this pack. Anyone who installs it gets these; anything they change themselves stays theirs.
modconfig-carried-other: {0} settings carried in this pack. Anyone who installs it gets these; anything they change themselves stays theirs.
modconfig-show-all-tip: Every setting Cairn can read, not only the ones you have changed.
modconfig-carry-tip: Carry this value in the pack.
modconfig-orphan: no mod in this pack has {0} any more
modconfig-footer: Saved into the pack as you tick. A setting ConfigLib keeps in its own file arrives once that mod has run here at least once.
modconfig-none-written: This pack's mods have written no settings Cairn can read yet. Play it once, and they will be here.
modconfig-no-baseline: Cairn has no record of what these mods first wrote, so it cannot tell which values you changed. It starts keeping one the next time you play this pack — until then, use Show all.
modconfig-none-changed: Nothing changed. Every setting is as its mod first wrote it — tick Show all to carry one anyway.
modconfig-unreadable: Could not read this pack's mod config: {0}
